statement: Crux AI will spend the $22 billion on Google TPUs and plans to bring its first 500 megawatts of capacity online in 2027, adding a large non-merchant accelerator fleet to the market.
why: Half a gigawatt of TPU-based cloud capacity funded and scheduled is compute that would otherwise likely have been bought as merchant GPUs, so it shifts where the next wave of accelerator spend lands.

impact.mechanism: A financed, dated TPU buildout enlarges the supply of non-NVIDIA accelerator capacity available for rent, giving customers an alternative to merchant GPU clusters.

evidence.excerpt: plans to bring its first 500 megawatts of capacity online in 2027

confidence.basis: Secondary reporting of a plan, not a filing; capacity is a 2027 target and the document gives no delivered-to-date figure.
